title: Annual Volume Rebate Thresholds and Rates for the Corporate Travel Programmes
content:
Each tier of the Corporate Travel Programmes publishes the annual booking value at which a volume rebate begins to accrue, and the rebate rate that applies to booking value above that threshold.

| Programme tier | Annual booking value at which a rebate begins to accrue | Rebate on annual booking value above the threshold |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Business Starter Programme | 0.00 USD | 0 per cent |
| Business Team Programme | 0.00 USD | 0 per cent |
| Business Pro Programme | 250000.00 USD | 0.5 per cent |
| Business Enterprise Programme | 1000000.00 USD | 1 per cent |
| Business Enterprise Plus Programme | 4000000.00 USD | 1.5 per cent |
| Business Global Programme | 12000000.00 USD | 2.25 per cent |

## Notes

1. No rebate figure is published for the Business Starter Programme or the Business Team Programme: the threshold of each stands at 0.00 USD and the rate of each at 0 per cent.
2. The published threshold rises from 250000.00 USD on the Business Pro Programme through 1000000.00 USD on the Business Enterprise Programme and 4000000.00 USD on the Business Enterprise Plus Programme to 12000000.00 USD on the Business Global Programme.
3. The published rate rises over the same four tiers from 0.5 per cent through 1.0 per cent and 1.5 per cent to 2.25 per cent.
4. The rate is published against booking value above the threshold, not against the whole of the annual booking value.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical)

Take a tier whose published threshold is 1000000.00 USD and whose published rate is 1.0 per cent. On a contract year's booking value of 1400000.00 USD, the value standing above the threshold is 400000.00 USD, and 1.0 per cent of that figure is 4000.00 USD.
